query: Does the 10 lakh cumulative Capital Market figure in UPI OC185B make a single IPO mandate limit 10 lakh?

claims.text: The 10 lakh figure in UPI OC185B represents a cumulative limit for the Capital Market category over 24 hours, not a single IPO mandate limit.
According to Annexure I of The cited source (circular 185B), the per-transaction limit for Capital Market is Rs 5 Lakh while the cumulative limit is Rs 10 Lakh.
claims.original_text: According to Annexure I of document S1 (circular 185B), the per-transaction limit for Capital Market is Rs 5 Lakh while the cumulative limit is Rs 10 Lakh.

claims.text: The cited source (circular 127) establishes that the per-transaction limit for UPI based ASBA IPO with Purpose Code 01 and MCC 6211 is Rs 5 Lakh.
claims.original_text: Document S2 (circular 127) establishes that the per-transaction limit for UPI based ASBA IPO with Purpose Code 01 and MCC 6211 is Rs 5 Lakh.

claims.text: The distinction between per-transaction ceilings and cumulative limits is maintained in circular 185B, where the cumulative column applies to 24-hour totals rather than individual mandates.

reasons: The local model accepted the selected evidence as support.
